concept: a stone gargoyle that perches motionless on the cathedral gutter until a thief passes beneath it
a drowned knight in rusted plate who still rides his skeletal horse along the causeway at low tide
a wax preacher whose sermons seal the wounds of its flock while its psalms wither the unbelievers
a tar-mouthed toad the size of a cart that drags cattle into the bog
a hollow suit of tourney armor that hurls its own lance and then thunders across the field to retrieve it
a clockwork bishop that blesses the poor by day and at night unfolds into a cage of brass ribs around whoever it has chosen
a lighthouse keeper's drowned wife who still climbs the stairs each night to light the lamp, and pulls anyone who follows her back down into the surf
a hermit crab the size of a wagon that wears a stolen bronze church bell as its shell and rings it by slamming its own body against the inside when it is wounded
